status: read-only pre-implementation recommendations; current root integration may be in progress

proposedContract.values: Nonempty partial top-level camera, light and background; camera and light, when present, are nonempty exact known-field records.
proposedContract.intent: SET only; no reset, remove, normalization or renderer-camera import.
proposedContract.status: Recommendation pending parent final contract, not an implemented API claim.

requiredBoundaries: Validate the entire bounded original source, apply all net leaf changes atomically, and validate the entire final source. Intermediate camera position/target and near/far combinations need not be valid.

Preserve all unrequested bytes, including BOM/CRLF, escaped decoded keys, ordering, exponents, signed zero and object identity. Same numeric value or same decoded string produces an exact byte no-op, not canonicalization.
Only requested scalar numeric or color-string value tokens are editable. Background/light.color strings do not justify modifying object colors, names, keys or any other string token.
Bridge verification must compare full before/after native models, exact requested changedPaths, and both numeric and string token inventories with every unapproved span unchanged.
Use separate environment proposal authority and domain capability. Shared source snapshot/host guards are reusable; copied or foreign-domain proposals convey no authority.

Readonly preview keeps getContext/getSource only. Its local orbit/zoom/reset camera is transient and must never update author camera or source. Explicit refresh reconstructs local view from the new authored model.

Environment authoring does not depend on WebGL availability and must not execute backend tools. Missing environment capability must leave old parse, preview, transform, objects and ordinary source editing available.

Application updates only the current source draft. Existing baseline/version/cache and normal Save conflict checks remain intact. Source path, document identity, reload token, revision, draft epoch and UI ownership are rechecked after all awaits.
Form intent and approval cover every raw checkbox/value and target identity; silent DOM mutation invalidates approval. Use a scoped hidden rule so layout styling cannot reveal inactive inputs.

existingEvidenceFromStaticRead.readonlyPreview: setupScene3DPreview takes only getContext/getSource; renderer maintains separate local camera copies and orbit/reset operations.
existingEvidenceFromStaticRead.sourceIdentity: captureScene3DAuthoringSource exact five-field source snapshot; existing host checks document, baseline, version, content and source/draft epochs.
existingEvidenceFromStaticRead.currentHostIntegration: An independent applyScene3DEnvironmentDraft wrapper is already present during concurrent implementation; this design report does not certify its pending pure/core/UI implementation.
existingEvidenceFromStaticRead.bounds: Reuse actual native schema1 camera safe-basis, minimum distance, near/far separation, directional-light safe-basis, RGB and 128 KiB limits without widening them.

recommendedIndependentTests: Final-valid camera position+target and near+far combined patch with an invalid sequential intermediate.
Zero energy valid; zero/vertical light direction and unusable camera rejected; tiny valid light direction remains raw while render normalization is temporary.
Exact semantic no-op for exponents, signed zero, escaped RGB values and mixed unchanged leaves; all-no-op has no approval.
Invalid mixed patch and final byte-budget overflow leave original bytes intact; duplicate decoded keys, null, unknown fields, accessors/sparse arrays/non-finite input rejected.
Forged correct requested values with rewritten keys, unrequested object transforms/colors, viewport or identity rejected.
Late close/new open, same-path document reload, source mutation at each awaited boundary, cross-domain brand and malformed completion receipt refused.
Readonly orbit/wheel/reset does not touch source; author environment patch plus explicit preview refresh uses the new authored camera/light/background.
Missing/unsupported new capability preserves old domains; normal Save external conflict remains visible; three languages and narrow layout retain approval/intent.
scopeLimits: Static design and baseline inspection only. No new operation, native/WASM, rendering, browser, prepared resource, installed desktop or device validation claimed.
